instrument_scope: H0-base only (PREREG r3 §7); not evidence for/against H1
unit: One human-written story response to one public r/WritingPrompts-derived prompt.

pre_coding_eligibility.rule: Prompt must begin [WP] or [CW] with an explicit create/build/invent/design/make-up/imagine/construct/develop/craft instruction and name a world/place category within 120 characters. No story text, category hits, or outcomes are used in selection.

denominator_alignment: PARTIAL / denominator mismatch: prompts ask world/place construction, but are not PREREG §2’s identical fixed P1 wording; dataset contains only English and permits narrative responses. Rates are descriptive H0-base baseline, not a matched human-vs-model experiment.

coding_reliability.status: UNVERIFIED / not completed: this run has one deterministic execution of the specified scorer; a second independent coding lane was not available in this task.
